target_customer: Teams where non-engineers want code changes to existing GitHub repos
problem: Non-engineers cannot change production code, and app builders like Lovable do not work on existing repositories.
business_model: Credit-based usage pricing ($50 per month for 500 credits upward) plus enterprise

founders.name: Ai Daniil Bekirov
founders.background_notes: YC page says dropped out of UCL.

technical_complexity.rationale: Running coding agents in isolated sandboxes with Slack and PR flows is standard engineering built on third-party agents.

defensibility.rationale: Built on Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode; Lovable or others could add an existing-repo mode.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not yet known; similar tools such as Base Code and ronda exist and Lovable is acquisitive per TechCrunch in March 2026.

market_need_then: Product and operations staff want to make small code changes; several tools target this workflow.

identity.visual_style: Product mockups of Slack and live runs

branding.community_and_virality: A solo founder essay is mentioned by press but was not found

brand_strength.rationale: Very generic dictionary word shared with other Sparkle and Sparkli products, which hurts search; no independent brand coverage.

outcome_analysis: Sparkles is an active Winter 2026 company led by a young solo founder with a prior startup background. It has public pricing and a clear wedge, but funding figures conflict and competitors can copy the idea, so the outcome is too early to read.
notes: Funding conflict: YesPress and a job listing snippet say $3.5M with YC and Moonfire; VCBacked and EveryDev say $500K from YC; PitchBook says $50K. The YC jobs page I opened did not mention funding, so none is recorded as a round. YC page says London and team size 2; one search summary said team size 1 and San Francisco. No dated competitor sources near the batch found, so the list is empty. Completeness pass: $3.5M is stated in the company's own YC jobs page (per search snippet) and in the founder's May 2026 essay per YesPress; the round date is not given. Other sources conflict (EveryDev $500K YC seed, Employbl $500K total, PitchBook $50K, Nordic9 undisclosed angel round) and are not summed. Not to be confused with Sparkli, a different company.
